## VZ Q3 2026 results (added 4:50 AM PT)
Source: Verizon's press release filed as Exhibit 99 to today's 8-K ([EX-99](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/732712/000073271226000049/a2026q3exhibit99.htm), [filing index](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/732712/000073271226000049/0000732712-26-000049-index.htm)).
- Adjusted EPS $1.31, up 8.3% y/y; GAAP EPS $1.25, up 6.8%.
- Total operating revenue $34.3B, up 1.5% y/y. Mobility and broadband service revenue $23.5B, up 2.9%; equipment revenue down 9.0% on fewer upgrades and lower subsidies.
- Postpaid phone net adds 406,000 (best Q3 in five years); postpaid net accounts +137,000; postpaid phone churn 0.94%, down 4 bps y/y. Broadband net adds 314,000 (159K fixed wireless, 155K fiber).
- Adjusted EBITDA $13.8B, up 8.0%, margin 40.2%. Q3 free cash flow $7.8B, up 12.1%.
- Signed a $2.0B+ AI infrastructure agreement with AWS.
- **Guidance raised (third straight quarter):** FY26 adjusted EPS $5.04–5.06 (7.0–7.5% growth, from 6.0–7.0%); postpaid phone net adds 1.1–1.2M (from upper half of 750K–1.0M); operating cash flow growth 3.5–5.0% (from 2.0–4.0%); FCF growth approaching 12% (from 9–10%); service revenue growth in the upper half of 2.5–3.0%, about 4% in Q4. Capex unchanged at $16.0–16.5B.
- Versus the MarketBeat consensus above: adjusted EPS beat ($1.31 vs about $1.27) and revenue came in under ($34.3B vs about $34.8B). That comparison is Hal's arithmetic on the two sourced figures.
- The release does not mention SpaceX, Starlink, or the cell-site talks. Premarket price reaction was not checked in this run (**unverified**); Cash Money's VZ levels and bias above were set before the report and were not updated.
